name: Wren Ashby
silhouette: Lean, barefoot on gunwales, patched jacket with too many pockets, a coil of line.
speech_rhythm: Quick, deflecting, answers questions with offers; understatement.
private_motivation: Get the Hullfolk something the town cannot take.
fear: Ending like Bram, sitting on a bollard remembering.
contradiction: The least sentimental Hullfolk learns the whole Song.
secret: Runs rifles for Sorrel through the reeds.

relationships.solas: buyer, and the man she fears
